frozen_protocol.purpose: fine-tune the released GENCO checkpoint as in finetune.ipynb, with a load-growth response term, and evaluate it later (evaluate_finetuned_loadgrowth, load_response_finetuned) against the released and the published fine-tuned model

differences_from_finetune.pairs: every regression target solved again with every load x (1 + 0.02) (loads only; generators unchanged; the slack takes the extra power), with the same solver policy and the same target criteria; a pair is used only if both states are targets
differences_from_finetune.response_loss: mean over the PQ buses of a micro-batch of 4 pairs of ((GENCO Vm change - AC Vm change) / 0.02)^2
differences_from_finetune.weight: step loss = published objective (as in finetune.ipynb) + w x response loss, w = (released-model published-objective loss on the pilot cases) / (released-model response loss on as many pairs), capped at 100.0
differences_from_finetune.budget: TRAIN_BUDGET_MIN = 105 (70 in finetune.ipynb), so that the same MAX_EPOCHS fit
differences_from_finetune.decision_rule: adopted only if, for seed 0, (a) the median load-growth slope on the 129 load_response scenarios is >= 0.85 and above the published fine-tuned model's, and (b) missed decisions per clustered frozen-test case fall against the released model with the paired 95 % CI below zero

frozen_protocol.objective: the released training objective, unchanged: graphkit MixedLoss of caseTexas_train.yaml = 0.9 x masked bus MSE (Vm, Va) + 0.1 x layered weighted physics residual (base weight 0.5), in the released normalisation

data.excluded_why: 0-1: base points of K1/N1/N2 (the storms of T2's near-fold test); 6, 16: the final evaluation F1 (T2's main test); 7: T2's forgetting check on released N-2 scenarios
data.labels: Newton-Raphson (lightsim2grid KLU) to 1e-8 p.u. from the pre-contingency, DC and flat starts with the branch check on; a case is a regression target only if verified, with one solution among the starts and a lowest voltage >= LOW_V_EXCLUDE; unresolved cases are kept as labels for the solvability head (notebook T2)
data.split: by base point: 10% of the training base points (seeded) are validation, never trained on

frozen_protocol.selection: the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss (the training objective on the validation split), evaluated every 100 optimizer steps and at the end of each epoch; the released model's own validation loss is the starting point
frozen_protocol.sizing: EPOCHS = min(4, max(1, floor(105 min / (pilot seconds per case x training cases)))); the pilot's weight updates are discarded
frozen_protocol.evaluation: notebook T2, frozen before this run: paired released vs fine-tuned on the 870 F1 cases (GENCO-alone misses against the verified reference, worst-bus voltage error, Newton iterations, verdicts), on soft-footprint N-20 cases built on the F1 base points (a construction held out of training), on released N-2 (block 7), N-10 and N-20 scenarios (forgetting), on the 120 K1 storms against their stored AC truth along the load sweep (near-fold response), and the solvability head

sizing.accumulation: loss of each micro-batch weighted by its share of the cases of its optimizer step; the last step of an epoch takes the remainder; no gradient carried across epochs
